facts.title: Beautiful Red Bell Cocktail
ingredients: ⅓ of a medium red bell pepper, sliced into two-inch long strips
½ to 1 teaspoons agave nectar or simple syrup
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a cocktail shaker, combine red pepper, basil and lime juice. Muddle until the red pepper is thoroughly smashed (it shouldn’t have any crunch left).
Add the gin, agave nectar and lots of ice. Put on the lid and shake like crazy.
Strain and pour into a chilled martini glass. Enjoy.

facts.summary: This refreshing summer cocktail is made with red bell pepper, basil, gin and lime. This recipe was inspired by Manifesto in Kansas City, MO.
